training_run_metadata.provenance_statement: The model was successfully retrained from scratch using MobileNetV3-Small on 7710 clean dual-domain records representing 6965 unique image files. All exact master blacklist collisions, 14 benchmark dHash near-duplicates, and 10 PlantDoc crop/zoom test-matching source families were purged prior to training.

exported_model_artifact.quantization: Float16 (FP16 Post-Training Optimization with Float32 input/output interfaces)

training_corpus_provenance.records_vs_unique_distinction: The model was trained using 7710 training records representing 6965 unique image files (6,600 clean PlantVillage + 370 clean PlantDoc repeated 3x = 1,110).

unique_hash_reconciliation_audit.audit_explanation: The 5 duplicate hashes are bitwise identical images duplicated within the upstream Kaggle PlantVillage mirror (vipoooool/new-plant-diseases-dataset) under different UUID-prefixed filenames. All 5 duplicate pairs belong to the exact same disease class (4 in Tomato Late Blight, 1 in Tomato Healthy), confirming zero label conflicts and exact arithmetic: 6595 unique PV hashes + 370 unique PD hashes = 6965 unique training hashes.
